title: Ekisuubizo Ekyayogerwa Ku Embers
intro: Oyimiridde ku mabbali g’omuliro ogw’eddungu ng’ebiwujjo byagwo bisaasaanyiziddwa n’obwegendereza. Abagenyi batuuka okusisinkana mu busirise, era obubaka bumu buggulawo emboozi y’okusuubiza, okwewuunya, n’ebiseera eby’omu maaso ebitannaba kutuukirira.
clues: Twasala ebanga okutuuka ku muweereza omwesigwa eyali mu ddungu.
Twayogedde n’omu eyali ayise ennimi z’omuliro olw’obunnyogovu n’obukuumi.
Twaleeta amawulire g’omwana omuwere eri omuntu eyali ayise emyaka gy’okuzaala.
Twaleeta amawulire ag’essanyu ag’omwana ow’obulenzi eri Ibrahim, era amawulire ag’ekyewuunyo gaaleka Ibrahim ng’aseka.
